dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Visible as a single, thin, high-contrast white band across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale bluish-white edges clearly delineate individual folded flight feathers against darker centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, trapezoidal yellowish-white patch on the posterior neck at the base of the crown.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, distinct boundary between the black crown and the yellowish-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, high-contrast white cheek patch bounded by a black hood and bib.
